title: Replace imitation with direct search on weak evolved structures
hypothesis: Direct rollout search escapes poor imitation trajectories in weak evolved structures by optimizing their existing parameters for task success.

prediction.against: Rollout-selected imitation fitting alone at an equal selection-episode budget
prediction.rationale: A ten-point gain would warrant replacing fitting for this stratum. Unlike Stage F's post-fit repair comparison, both treatments start from the frozen original parameter vector and neither receives repair. Remote spend requires per-idea approval.

code_changes: scripts/stage_f.py: add the research-protocol CLI used above. Before new evaluations, select the two lowest archived-success non-bank evolved structures referenced by config/stage_f/selection.json; fail closed if fewer than two exist. Treat them only as diagnostic subjects, never as fittable-lane parents.

scripts/stage_f.py: for each structure and three optimizer seeds, compare eight parameter vectors from the existing Stage F search operator, including the original vector, against imitation checkpoints {0,125,250,375,500,625,750,1000}. Freeze topology and legal parameter bounds; disable all repair.

scripts/stage_f.py: each arm spends eighty selection episodes on the same ten-case probe and uses success-first rollout selection, never validation loss. Evaluate both selected controllers on the same fifty fresh confirmation cases: 2 structures x 3 seeds x (80+80+50+50) = 1560 episodes.

scripts/stage_f.py: average paired outcomes over the fixed structures and optimizer restarts within each confirmation placement before computing the paired interval; do not label restarts independent data replicates. Perform no promotions.
config/manifests/research/: generate the two development-only manifests named above. Force CPU execution, require remote-spend approval, and stop the remote instance afterward.

falsified_by: An upper paired 95% confidence bound below +0.10 refutes the predicted gain; an interval including zero is inconclusive about directional superiority. Support requires at least +0.10 with a lower bound above zero.
